## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `58de368f04d9392425076b29eb2dc4eb5fb064f3`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/project-forms.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/seat-lifecycle.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/seat-post-protocol.md + scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs (the H70/H71 rows, their sweep wiring and battery — the gate the rule is enforced by, read as one change with it)

Written 2026-11-01T14:03Z by the at-tier subagent of `domain:skills#2`; inputs = card #28642 (body + 3 comments), PR #28687 (body, file list, net diff vs `main` at this head), the head's check-runs. The dev's report and the PR body were read as claims and checked against the tree, not adopted.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Published accept set / public surface: unchanged — right.** The four changed paths are `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/**` (governed rules text) and `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` (PM tooling, not a package, not in `GOVERNED_SURFACES`). No `packages/**`, no `exports` map, no `.d.ts`, no error code. `Clause-②: no` on the PR body and on the claim (6558432195) is the correct declaration.
- **Review face: rules (CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER) — right.** `reviewFace` on the file list returns the three references files as `hits`; the script is cited code.
- **Landing tier by the register: Tier S — triage's "Tier H" is not the register's reading.** SKILL.md:204 and AGENTS.md ¶14 put the whole of `.claude/**` in Tier S; `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` is not a governed path. Triage 6556985958 nonetheless made the maintainer's approval the ruling for this rule change, and the dev's claim and PR body accept that condition. Judged: the mechanical path is Tier S (this record is the record of record), and the maintainer's approval stays owed as the card-level ruling before ready/enqueue — see ③.
- **Rules text: three files, net 0 lines each (54/96/88 on `main` and at head), every edited line ≤ 120 bytes (measured 103 / 119 / 118 / 119 / 116 / 120 / 116) — right;** `SKILL.md` and `dispatch-runbook.md` untouched, as the claim's line budget stated. The 〈断粮〉 patrol line is deleted and each clause has a surviving home: hourly → `seat-post-protocol.md` L66; standby items → `seat-lifecycle.md` L89–91; wall note on the stub → `seat-post-protocol.md` L18; no timer chain → SKILL.md:72.
- **Half-state registry: H70 → `state`, H71 → `stall`, both emitted from `sweepInto`, both report-only (no label, title, body or assignee write anywhere in the added code) — right.** Zero extra requests holds: H70 reads the seat post's own body inside the existing `pm:seat` branch; H71's `onDutyLanes` and candidates come from `seen`, and `SEEN_LABEL_PAGES` already lists `pm:seat` and `pm:queue`.
- **Self-test roster: one new battery `H70/H71 seat patrol` pinned at 26 under 27 recorded cases; `SELF_TEST_BATTERY_FLOOR` stays 10 and the "TEN batteries" case still holds with eleven declared — right.** `directiveValues`' JSDoc key union gains `'Seam'|'Patrol'`: doc-only, H68 already called it with `'Seam'` on `main`.
- **Check-runs on this head: every completed non-skipped run is `success`** (Lint & Repo Gates, Lint · PM dispatch-gates — the ratchet/id-lint/frame-sync/governed-prose family —, Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests, Governed Surface Queue Guard, PR-body guards, Type Check ×6, Test UI, Dogfood, Check PR Size, and `Live half-state sweep` — the standing report-only caller of the script, green with the new rows in it). Still `in_progress` at write time: `Test Core (1/8)` only, a product shard no path here feeds. No red, no merge-base signature to discount.

### ② Semver level

No publishable package is touched; no changeset exists and the PR carries `skip-changeset` — matches what the diff publishes (nothing). `Clause-②: no` is consistent on the PR body and the claim; there is no `(narrowing)` arm, so no narrowing face is owed. Correct.

### ③ Boundary flags

Author: `objectstack-fleet[bot]` (relay) — no off-relay login to name.

Dev deviations (PR body "Acceptance notes" / report `deviations`):
- **`Notify: seat-online` key not extended** — accepted. Card Wanted ① wanted the patrol on the `seat-online` record too; the key template at `project-forms.md` L44 is parsed by `record-recognisers.mjs`, outside this claim's surface, and the mailbox-keys card is the serial behind this one. The rule as written (L41) says the stub carries it, and H70 reads the stub, so the tree is self-consistent. The half still owed goes to that serial card, not to this PR.
- **H71 drops "spare concurrency"** — accepted. No seat post states a cap machine-readably; the row text says so and the remedy allows "in hand at its limit".
- **`dispatch-runbook.md` untouched; Wanted ④ lives at `seat-lifecycle.md` L89** — accepted; the runbook's 〈巡查常设项〉 still names the cross-account review and fork-PR items, which L89's "待命五项" reaches by its pointer.
- **「含前提过时」 not re-homed** — accepted: `execution-duties.md` L14 already makes the premise check a per-dispatch duty.
- **No director exemption on L41** — accepted: SKILL.md:72, `project-forms.md` L26 and `seat-post-protocol.md` L66 carry it, and H70 excludes the director title in code.
- **H70 reuses `seatIsHeld`** — accepted, consistent with H32; #19357 (`🟢 session_…`) will read as held, which is right (a held lane seat).
- **Trailer casing** — outside the hits; not reviewed here.

`open_questions`:
- **OQ1 (Tier S vs Tier H → landing path):** answered. By the register this PR is Tier S (see ①); triage's note is not a re-tiering but a card-level condition: the maintainer's approval is the ruling for the rule change. So the path is the dev's option A: this record stands as the Tier S record of record, and the owning seat does not flip ready or enqueue before the maintainer's approval is on the PR. ⛔ Not a reason to request a CODEOWNERS review from the seat's own account.
- **OQ2 (instrument-discipline L9: a new patrol row needs the maintainer's words on the card):** escalated to the maintainer with the approval. The card's filing gate quotes the maintainer verbatim (「28560 等了4 个小时，是你的技能有什么问题吗」, 「为什么会停了定时巡查，skills 是否需要优化」), which is the form L9 asks for; whether a question authorises two report rows is the maintainer's call, and the PR's 速读 asks for exactly that approval. Until it is given, H70/H71 are unauthorised and the PR stays draft. The rows cost nothing and write nothing, so the approval is the only remaining gate.

### ④ Design judgment

Scenario accepted against: #28560 (p1, `domain:spec`) in `pm:queue` 4.5 h with seat 4 (#18917) 🟢 and idle; the seat never created its routine, stopped one-shot checks when the queue emptied, and no reading on the board showed either half.

**`project-forms.md` L26 — holds.** 「坐席即建巡查 routine(见 `seat-lifecycle.md`)」 keeps the triage bare-card round and the director exemption on the same line; the pointer lands on the one home. No finding.

**`seat-lifecycle.md` L41–42, L88–89, deleted L97 — holds.** L41 makes creation a step of the seating act, visible on the stub and deleted in the same act as `seat-offline`, which is the exact gap the incident measured (creation was never a step; the post could not show its absence). L88 names the habit that overrode the rule and forbids it; SKILL.md:74's 自退 is the round's self-exit and the routine outlives it, so L88 and 自退 do not collide; L87's 「队列空 ⇒ 停」 is scoped to one-shot invocations already. L89 names the patrol's work (claim to `batch`, then the five standby items) and keeps the existing interval pointer. L42 keeps the `seat-online` key pointer and the Routine-seat mailbox note. `create_trigger` bound to the seated session is what `seat-post-protocol.md` L58/L60 already distinguish from a new-session routine.
- **should-fix (unit of the routine):** SKILL.md:72 says 「每项目一个自建自绑巡查 routine」 while L41 and `project-forms.md` L26 say 「坐席即建」, i.e. one per seat; `project-forms.md` L25 opens one seat thread per seat, so a project seated on two lanes (`pm-dispatch ui skills`) reads two routines from the references and one from SKILL.md. Resolve on a follow-up (SKILL.md is outside this surface): either L41 says 「本席线程一个」 or SKILL.md:72's unit becomes the seat.

**`seat-post-protocol.md` L18, L66 — holds.** The stub gains `Patrol:` as a fixed line beside the optional wall note, and L66 names the spelling `Patrol: TRIGGER_ID · CRON` as the only place the current value lives, keeping 「协议不复制当前值」. Checked against the reader: `DIRECTIVE_PREFIX` + `directiveKey('Patrol')` accept the bare line, `- **Patrol:** …` and a backticked line, and refuse `Patrol:` with nothing after it and a mid-sentence mention — the battery pins all four.

**Cited gate `check-half-states.mjs`, H70/H71 (read, not reviewed; findings are on the rule-with-gate):** H70 scope traced = `pm:seat` ∧ open ∧ not a PR ∧ `seatIsHeld` ∧ not director ∧ no `Patrol:` line; H71 = `pm:queue` ∧ ¬`pm:epic` ∧ no assignee ∧ a `domain:*` label (alias-resolved) whose lane has a 🟢 seat post (`seatOnDuty`, non-foreign) ∧ `updated_at` older than 2 h or unreadable. Both match the rule text and the PR body's description; the 2 h boundary (1h59 clean / 2h01 fires) and the unreadable-stamp arm are pinned.
- **should-fix (H71 remedy vs the red line):** an unassigned `pm:queue` card carrying `needs-user-decision` or `pm:retriage` legally pairs with `pm:queue` (H29's vocabulary) yet is not a candidate (`execution-duties.md` L8) and must never be dispatched (SKILL.md L29); H71 still fires on it with the remedy "that seat claims it". Live today both pairs count 0, so no false reading is on the board; exclude the two labels in `h71UnclaimedOnDutyLane` and pin one case.
- **should-fix (director title anchor):** `DIRECTOR_SEAT_TITLE` anchors `总监` at the start of the seat name; the live title `director(项目总监)` matches via `director`, but a retitle to `[PM seat] 项目总监 — 🟢 …` would make H70 fire on the director seat. Match the seat-name half, not its first character.

No must-fix: the rule holds against the incident it is accepted against, the gate reads the exact spelling the rule names, and both rows are readings that write nothing.
